builder.nothingInScope: Nothing available in the current scope.
builder.noConditionsCriteria: Without criteria, every ad is considered mature — even the ones that barely started running. Add at least one condition.
builder.noConditionsGroup: A group with no conditions shows every creative in the scope. Add at least one for the group to mean something.

criteria.saveFailed: Could not save the criteria. Please try again.

chart.insufficientChart: Not enough data for the chart.
chart.attributionNote: Estimated impact per ad. Comparison: last day vs. previous — conversions have an attribution window (recent days may be under-reported).
chart.normalizeHint: Turn on to find correlations easily.
chart.needsActionType: CPR, Page Conv and Results require a selected conversion type.

score.d: Shows the creative's final composite score as read in the Explorer.
score.t: Synthetic score on a 0 to 10 scale, calculated from the creative's signals.

spend.d: Shows how much was invested in the ad in the selected period.
spend.t: Sum of the spend attributed to the filtered set of dates.

cpm.d: Shows the cost to generate a thousand impressions of the ad.

frequency.d: Shows how many times, on average, each person saw the ad.
frequency.t: Ratio between total impressions and reach.

scroll_stop.d: Measures the ad's ability to stop the scroll right at the start.
scroll_stop.t: Percentage that stopped in the first second of the video.

hook.d: Shows how strong the ad's opening is at capturing attention.
hook.t: Initial retention rate in the first 3 seconds.

hold_rate.d: Coherence between the Hook and the rest of the ad.
hold_rate.t: Retention rate between the Hook (3s) and Trueplay (15s).

video_watched_p50.d: Shows how many people reached the halfway point of the video.
video_watched_p50.t: Percentage of views that reached 50% of the duration.

video_watched_p75.d: Shows how many people reached 75% of the video.
video_watched_p75.t: Percentage of views that reached 75% of the duration.

ctr.d: Shows the click-through rate generated by the ad over impressions.

website_ctr.d: Shows the click-through rate specifically on the ad's link.
website_ctr.t: Inline link clicks divided by impressions.

connect_rate.d: Shows how many clicks turned into real visits to the page.
connect_rate.t: LPV divided by inline link clicks.

page_conv.d: Shows how efficient the page is at converting visits into results.

cpmql.d: Shows the cost to generate a marketing qualified lead.

cpr.d: Shows how much it costs to generate one result of the selected conversion.

cpc.d: Shows how much each click received by the ad costs.

cplc.d: Shows how much each click on the ad's link costs.

mqls.d: Shows the volume of qualified leads generated in the period.
mqls.t: Total count of marketing qualified leads.

results.d: Shows the total of the currently selected conversion.
results.t: Sum of the conversions of the chosen action type.

impressions.d: Shows the total number of times the ad was displayed.

clicks.d: Shows the total clicks received by the ad.
clicks.t: Includes all clicks counted in delivery.

lpv.d: Shows how many real views the landing page received.
lpv.t: Landing page views after the ad click.

plays.d: Shows how many video plays were recorded.
plays.t: Total started plays of the video creative.

thruplays.d: Shows how many people watched the video to the end (or 15s).
thruplays.t: Total complete plays, or plays of at least 15 seconds (video_thruplay_watched_actions).

reach.d: Shows how many unique people received the ad.
reach.t: Estimated count of unique users reached.

leadscore_avg.d: Shows the average quality of the leads generated by the ad.
leadscore_avg.t: Average of the leadscore_values received via spreadsheet, weighted by the number of leads.

mql_rate.d: Shows what share of the ad's leads arrived qualified.
mql_rate.t: MQLs divided by the TOTAL leads (not by the non-MQLs). Scale 0-1.

cpl_ceiling.d: How much you can pay for a lead from this ad without dropping below the desired margin, given who it brings in.
cpl_ceiling.t: Σ share of leads in the band × conversion × ticket × (what is left − desired margin), using the pack's economics. Counts only scored leads.

cpl_actual.d: How much each scored lead really cost. This is the cost to compare with CPL Max, not CPR (which divides by Meta's results).
cpl_actual.t: Spend ÷ scored leads from the spreadsheet. Same denominator as CPL Max and Margin.

leads_scored.d: How many leads from the spreadsheet matched this ad and have a score. It is the divisor of CPL Real and Margin: use it to check the math.
leads_scored.t: Count of leads with a leadscore coming from the spreadsheet. Denominator of CPL Real, CPL Max and Margin.

lead_margin.d: How much is left of the expected revenue after product, costs and what the lead cost. Compare with the desired margin.
lead_margin.t: (expected contribution per lead − spend ÷ scored leads) ÷ expected revenue per lead. Over revenue (D15). Scale 0-1.

diagnostic.lowVolume: Low volume in the last few days — no reliable conclusion.
diagnostic.stableFunnelShifted: {target} stable ({value}), but the funnel shifted: {worsened} got worse and {improved} offset it.
diagnostic.unidentifiedCause: {target} {direction, select, up {rose} other {fell}} {value} ({pct}) — cause could not be identified.
